Model access

Pick a provider and paste your own API key. DeepSeek is pre-configured and works out of the box. If a call fails, PHAROS falls back to the built-in simulation engine so nothing blocks you.

🔍

Keys are stored only in your browser localStorage and are sent nowhere except the provider you configure.
This copy ships without any API key — paste your own to go live, or leave it empty to explore on the built-in simulation engine.

Acting as

PHAROS is a shared company workspace: everyone sees the same project data, but roles differ in what they can do. Switch identity to see how permissions change the decision gates.

Switch workspace

Each workspace belongs to one company and is isolated from the others. Inside a workspace, all members share the same project data.

Add a company workspace

A workspace is one company. Data inside it is shared by every member and isolated from other companies. You become the Owner, and a first project is created for you.

New project

A project is one product going to one market. Everything the agents produce — personas, angles, copy, creative, compliance records — is filed under it, and the whole workspace can see it.

Platform

Everything this platform has sent us, and nothing else. Pick an owner and turn it into a task.

Notifications

Pushed to you instead of waiting to be asked: seasonal peaks 30 days ahead, competitor moves, critical compliance findings, expiring certificates and overdue tasks.
